excerpt: I am a fresh graduate data engineer working at a small company in the oil and drilling industry. I was hired 6 months ago as a freelance data engineer, and after proving myself through my work quality, I am now essentially functioning as a tech lead, with full responsibility and ownership of designing, implementing, and hiring for the projects I'm assigned. Our company is not a tech company, so I only have a couple of tech-oriented colleagues, and I barely interact with them.
